<a id="page-theme"></a>
# Text and theme

Text, its looks and its style keys, the theme's names for colors and styles, and text direction. Open it when a text
needs a size, weight, font, line height or a theme color, or the page has a dark mode.

<a id="theme-text"></a>
## Text

`Text "…"` is body text; a look is a variant (`Text.title`, `Text.muted`; the list is in
[NOTATION.md](NOTATION.md#notation-words)). `size`, `weight` and `color` set its style; any other field of its
style is a key by its own name (`letterSpacing`, `fontFamily`, `height` for the line height, `decoration`).
`{name}` in the text shows a value.

```notation
Column gap=4
  Text.heading2 "Hello" size=32 color=#FF2563EB
  Text "Two lines at most" maxLines=2 overflow=ellipsis
  Text.title "In the theme's primary" color=primary
```

<a id="theme-runs-links-and-marks-in-a-text"></a>
### Runs: links and marks in a text

A part of a text in its own style, or a link, is a run over its characters: `runs=[…]`, each
[TextRun](#type-TextRun) a range `start` to `end` (the end not included) with its `style` and its `link`, over the
text's own style. A run holds no text of its own; it styles the text that is there (a run written with `"text"` and
no `start` is that text where the line first has it; a text the line does not have is said). A run written whole is
a record:

```notation
Text "Feeling stuck? Find help here." runs=[{"start":15,"end":29,"style":{"color":"#FF545CEA","fontWeight":600},"link":"https://example.com/help"}]
```

A run with a `link` takes a tap of its own: the tap opens the link (`https://…`, `mailto:…`, `tel:…`), or, when the text has
`onLinkTap`, runs it instead with `result.link`, `result.text`, `result.start` and `result.end`, so a link may name
anything of the app (`link="restart"`). The rest of the text keeps the text's own `onTap`. Runs are usually worked
out: `regexMatches(text, pattern)` gives each match of a pattern and where it is, `matchRanges(text, query)` the
parts that match a search; `map` makes each a run, and `concat` puts kinds of run together. A run written later
wins where two style the same characters (a search mark inside a link keeps both looks).

```notation
state msg="Write care@nocd.com or call +1 555 010 2233 for help."
state legal="By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy."
state q="help"
state opened=""
Column gap=8
  Text "{msg}" runs={concat(map(regexMatches(msg, "[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+|\+?\d[\d ]{6,}\d"), m => {start: m.start, end: m.end, link: contains(m.text, "@") ? "mailto:" + m.text : "tel:" + replace(m.text, " ", ""), style: {color: "#FF2563EB", decoration: "underline"}}), map(matchRanges(msg, q), r => {start: r[0], end: r[1], style: {backgroundColor: "#FFFDE68A"}}))}
  Text "{legal}" runs={map(regexMatches(legal, "Terms|Privacy Policy"), m => {start: m.start, end: m.end, link: m.text, style: {fontWeight: 700}})} onLinkTap={opened=result.link}
  Text "Opened: {opened}"
```

A count in braces inside a formula's text (`\d{3}`, `{2,4}`, `{,5}`) is the pattern's, not a value read.

A theme color or text style is written by its name (`color=primary`, `color=onSurface`, `style=title`): the
document's theme gives it. A key written after a named style changes only that key, at every width:
`style=title size=13` and `style=title phone.size=13` are the title at 13, its colour and weight kept (`from=title`
is the same; no `size=null` is needed). The theme itself is in the site's files ([design-systems.md](design-systems.md)).

A color of the site's own (its theme's `colors` in `site.json`, [site.md](site.md)) is read by its name in a
formula too, as `theme.<name>`, on a page and in a defined word: `fill={mine ? theme.mine : theme.theirs}`,
`border={theme.line}`. Written plain, `color=theme.ink` is `color=ink`. Either way it is the color the theme gives
as the page runs: its value under `dark` in dark mode. A defined word that reads a name the theme does not declare
is said, with the names it does; the color is added to the theme's `colors` (its dark value under `dark`).

```notation
state mine=true
Column gap=4 pad=12 fill={mine ? theme.mine : theme.theirs} radius=18
  Text "Booked it" color={mine ? "#FFFFFFFF" : theme.ink}
```

```notation
Button "Dark mode" onTap={setThemeMode mode=dark}
```

`setThemeMode dark` and `setThemeMode {isDark ? "light" : "dark"}` (its one value written alone) are the same.

A site that is dark by design says so in its theme, `"mode": "dark"` in `site.json` with its dark colors under
`dark` ([site.md](site.md)): it opens dark everywhere, with no action. The theme also names what the page words
draw in: a style `<look>Page` beside `<look>` (`heading1Page`, `leadPage`, `bodyPage`) is a text's on a website's
page, `colors.card` a card's ground, `colors.selectedRow` a chosen row's fill; and a band of a page with a
ground of its own (`Section fill=`, `gradient=`, `image=`) gives its texts the ink that reads on it
([navigation.md](navigation.md)).

<a id="theme-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-text"></a>
### `Text` (`text`)

Flutter `Text.rich`.

- Written `Text`; also `Text.pageTitle`, `Text.heading1`, `Text.heading2`, `Text.heading3`, `Text.sectionTitle`, `Text.panelTitle`, `Text.body`, `Text.bodySecondary`, `Text.fieldLabel`, `Text.caption`, `Text.mono`, `Text.title`, `Text.heading`, `Text.strong`, `Text.small`, `Text.muted`, `Text.danger`, `Text.success`. Level 0 (Core).
- `Text "…"` sets `props.text`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).
- The fields of its text style ([TextStyle](#type-TextStyle)) are keys by their own names: `letterSpacing=0.4`, `fontFamily="Inter"`.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` | 0 | The text shown. May hold expressions: `"Hello, ${user.name}"`. |
| `shortcut` | text | `""` | 0 | A key combination rendered with this platform's modifier names. |
| `style` | [TextStyle](#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | 0 | Base style for the whole text. |
| `runs` | list of [TextRun](#type-TextRun) | `[]` | 0 | Styled ranges over `text`, merged over `style`. |
| `textAlign` | `left` `right` `center` `justify` `start` `end` | `start` | 0 | How lines are aligned inside the node's width (Flutter's `TextAlign`). |
| `textAlignVertical` | `top` `center` `bottom` | `top` | 0 | Where the lines sit when the node is taller than they are. |
| `maxLines` | whole number |  | 0 | At most this many lines; the rest is cut as `overflow` says. Null: no limit. |
| `overflow` | `clip` `fade` `ellipsis` `visible` | `clip` | 0 | What shows where the text is cut by `maxLines` or the node's size (Flutter's `TextOverflow`): `clip`, `fade`, `ellipsis`, `visible`. |
| `selectable` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | The user can select and copy the text (Flutter's `SelectableText`). |
| `live` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Announces changes to this text to a screen reader without moving focus. |
| `scaleDown` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Shrinks the whole text to fit its width, keeping its lines (`FittedBox(fit: BoxFit.scaleDown)`). |
| `markdown` | JSON |  | 0 | Markdown look for the text (bold, italic, code, links, @mentions, lists); null shows the text as written. |

<a id="theme-behaviors"></a>
## Keys any line takes here

<a id="behavior-textDirection"></a>
### `textDirection` (behavior)

Null inherits.

Written `textDirection=…` on any line (`ltr` `rtl`). Level 0.

<a id="behavior-defaultTextStyle"></a>
### `defaultTextStyle` (behavior)

The text style every text style of this node and its descendants is merged over (Flutter's DefaultTextStyle); the nearest one wins ({} gives Flutter's defaults back). Unset everywhere: Flutter's defaults, the font's own line height.

Written `defaultTextStyle={…}` on any line ([TextStyle](#type-TextStyle)). Level 0.
 Each field of its record (TextStyle) is a key of its own, dotted: `defaultTextStyle.from=…`.

<a id="type-TextStyle"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultTextStyle.from` | text |  | The name of one of the project's text styles (the site manifest's `theme.textStyles`) this style starts from, as `Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge.merge(...)`: the fields written here change it. `"style": "title"` is short for `{"from": "title"}`. |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontFamily` | text |  | The font family (`"Inter"`); `fontWeight` picks its file. Without one: the platform's default (Roboto). |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontFamilyFallback` | list of text | `[]` | The families tried, in order, for a glyph fontFamily lacks (`["Roboto", "Noto Sans"]`). |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontWeight` | [FontWeight](values.md#type-FontWeight) |  | Flutter's `FontWeight`: 100–900, in hundreds. |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontStyle` | `normal` `italic` |  | `normal` or `italic`. |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontSize` | number (≥ 0) |  | The font size in logical pixels. Without one: 12. |
| `defaultTextStyle.color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Solid text color. |
| `defaultTextStyle.foreground` | [Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint) |  | A gradient or image paint for the glyphs, used instead of `color`. |
| `defaultTextStyle.letterSpacing` | number |  | Logical pixels between letters. |
| `defaultTextStyle.height` | number (≥ 0) |  | Line height as a multiple of the font size. Unset: the inherited defaultTextStyle's, else the font's own (Flutter's height: null, CSS line-height: normal). |
| `defaultTextStyle.decoration` | `none` `underline` `overline` `lineThrough` |  | A line through the text: `underline`, `overline`, `lineThrough` or `none`. |
| `defaultTextStyle.decorationColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The color of the `decoration` line; without one, the text's color. |
| `defaultTextStyle.backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Painted behind the glyphs. |
| `defaultTextStyle.decorationStyle` | `solid` `double` `dotted` `dashed` `wavy` |  | The `decoration` line's style: `solid`, `double`, `dotted`, `dashed`, `wavy`. |
| `defaultTextStyle.decorationThickness` | number |  | The `decoration` line's thickness, as a multiple of the font's default. |
| `defaultTextStyle.tabularFigures` | `true`/`false` |  | Fixed-width digits (`OpenTypeFeature.tabularFigures`). |
| `defaultTextStyle.fontFeatures` | list of [FontFeature](values.md#type-FontFeature) | `[]` | OpenType feature settings (`"lnum"`, `"ss01"`, `"liga=0"`). |
| `defaultTextStyle.leadingDistribution` | `proportional` `even` |  | Where a line's extra (or missing) height goes (`TextStyle .leadingDistribution`); null is Flutter's default, proportional. |
| `defaultTextStyle.shadows` | list of [Effect](decoration.md#type-Effect) | `[]` | Text shadows (drop shadows only). |

<a id="theme-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onLinkTap`](events.md#trigger-linkTap).
- Actions: [`setThemeMode`](events.md#action-setThemeMode).

<a id="theme-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-TextRun"></a>
### TextRun

A styled range of a text's characters, `[start, end)`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | whole number | `0` |  |
| `end` | whole number | `0` |  |
| `style` | [TextStyle](#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  |
| `link` | text |  | What a tap on the run means: a URL it opens (`https:`, `mailto:`, `tel:`, an app link), or, on a text with a `linkTap` reaction, the value that reaction reads as `result.link` instead. |

<a id="theme-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="theme-example-theme-md-eyebrow-title"></a>
### theme.md: eyebrow, title

From [theme.md](../theme.md) (the block at line 16 of its template, pages/theme.md); its nodes in a column.

```notation
Column#example
  Text#eyebrow "OUR MENU" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":18} style=eyebrow
  Text#title "Fire, smoke and season" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":40} style=title
  Text#note "Cooked over oak." size=13 color=ember from=body w={"fill":342} h={"hug":24}
  box#rule w=120 h=4 fill=ember
```

<a id="theme-example-theme-md-setthememode"></a>
### theme.md: setThemeMode

From [theme.md](../theme.md) (the block at line 101 of its template, pages/theme.md); the action on a button's tap.

```notation
Button#run "Run" onTap={setThemeMode mode={theme.isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'}}
```

<a id="theme-example-theme-home-json"></a>
### theme/home.json

From [`theme/home.json`](../tests.md).

```notation
canvas h=844 fill=paper
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Text#eb "OUR MENU" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":18} style=eyebrow
  Text#t "Fire, smoke and season" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":40} style=title
  Text#p "Cooked over oak, served at the counter." w={"fill":342} h={"hug":24} style=body
  box#q w=120 h=4 fill=ember
```

<a id="theme-example-theme-md-schema-pages"></a>
### theme.md: schema, pages

From [theme.md](../theme.md) (the block at line 140 of its template, pages/theme.md). It is a site's manifest (`site.json`), not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": ["home.json"],
  "fonts": [
    {"family": "Fraunces", "fonts": [
      {"asset": "fonts/fraunces-latin-400-normal.woff"},
      {"asset": "fonts/fraunces-latin-700-normal.woff", "weight": 700},
      {"asset": "fonts/fraunces-latin-400-italic.woff", "style": "italic"}
    ]}
  ],
  "theme": {"fontFamily": "Fraunces", "textStyles": {"body": {"fontFamily": "Fraunces", "fontSize": 17}}}
}
```
